ITEM 1 | Cubed pieces, roughly 1.5-2 cm each, cream-white to pale tan with lightly browned edges on several sides, firm matte surface with slightly porous texture, holding their shape, scattered densely over the top and middle of the bowl | 210
ITEM 2 | Bright green broccoli florets, about 2-3 cm across, slightly glossy and firm, with small stems, scattered around the rim and among the greens | 75
ITEM 3 | Mixed loose salad greens, mostly leafy and crisp, in light and dark green tones with some ruffled edges, forming a bed across the bowl base | 90
ITEM 4 | Thin slices of reddish-brown cooked meat or sausage-like pieces, moist with slight sheen, partly hidden under the cubes on the right side of the bowl | 40
